CIS_1_1.title: Disable insecure services (Telnet, FTP, cleartext HTTP, cleartext API)
CIS_1_1.rationale: Cleartext protocols expose administrative credentials and are vulnerable to interception and spoofing.

CIS_1_2.title: Disable or rename default admin user ('admin')
CIS_1_2.rationale: The default admin user is the primary target in automated brute-force attacks.

CIS_1_3.title: Restrict authorized IP subnets for WinBox and REST API
CIS_1_3.rationale: Restricting management access to trusted subnets prevents attacks originating from untrusted networks.

CIS_1_4.title: Protection against Open DNS Resolver on public interfaces
CIS_1_4.rationale: An open DNS resolver allows threat actors to abuse the router as an amplifier in volumetric DDoS attacks.

CIS_1_5.title: Disable MAC-Server and Neighbor Discovery on WAN interfaces
CIS_1_5.rationale: MNDP, CDP, and LLDP broadcast topology and identity details in cleartext across the link layer to untrusted networks.

CIS_1_6.title: Security patching and updates for RouterOS and RouterBOOT firmware
CIS_1_6.rationale: Keeping RouterOS and RouterBOOT on the stable patch branch resolves known CVEs and kernel vulnerabilities.

CIS_1_7.title: Strict Bogon / RFC 1918 packet filtering on WAN ingress
CIS_1_7.rationale: Packets originating from unallocated or private prefixes on WAN signify IP spoofing and DDoS attacks.

CIS_1_8.title: Dynamic defense against brute-force attacks (SSH/WinBox)
CIS_1_8.rationale: Automated dynamic blacklisting limits the capability of mass port scanners to compromise management credentials.

CIS_1_9.title: Strong VPN cryptography (prohibition of DES, 3DES, and MD5)
CIS_1_9.rationale: Deprecated ciphers (DES/3DES/MD5) are vulnerable to collision attacks and cryptanalytic decryption.

CIS_1_10.title: Isolation of management traffic on dedicated VLAN
CIS_1_10.rationale: Segregating control and management planes from subscriber payload via 802.1Q VLANs prevents traffic eavesdropping.

CIS_2_1.title: BGP peering security and boundaries (Prefix-Limit, TCP-AO / MD5)
CIS_2_1.rationale: Cryptographic peer authentication prevents fraudulent prefix injections (BGP hijacking) and TCP reset attacks.

CIS_2_2.title: Selective high-performance FastTrack (prevent QoS bypass)
CIS_2_2.rationale: FastTrack must bypass only non-shaped packets to ensure bandwidth management and latency policies are honored.

CIS_ISP_1.title: Bogon and Martian packet filtering on ingress (RFC 1918, RFC 6598, RFC 5737)
CIS_ISP_1.rationale: Drops non-routable ingress traffic on the WAN perimeter before consuming stateful connection tracking CPU cycles.

CIS_ISP_2.title: Complete Open DNS Resolver protection on WAN
CIS_ISP_2.rationale: Blocks incoming public DNS queries, preventing the router from being exploited in DNS reflection amplification attacks.

CIS_ISP_3.title: Cryptographic authentication on BGP peerings (MD5 / TCP-AO)
CIS_ISP_3.rationale: Enforces TCP MD5 or TCP-AO signatures on all BGP peers to eliminate rogue in-flight route manipulation.

CIS_ISP_4.title: Control Plane Policing (CoPP) for signaling and management traffic
CIS_ISP_4.rationale: Establishes rate-limiting quotas on control plane traffic (BGP, OSPF, ICMP) destined directly to the router CPU.

CIS_ISP_5.title: Out-of-band management isolation via dedicated Management VRF
CIS_ISP_5.rationale: Isolates control plane routing tables and management sockets inside a distinct VRF separate from client traffic.

CIS_ISP_6.title: Cryptographic authentication for OSPFv2/v3 (SHA-256)
CIS_ISP_6.rationale: Prevents rogue internal actors or transit links from injecting unauthorized LSAs or manipulating the SPF tree.

CIS_ISP_7.title: Suppression of ICMP Redirects and unreachable response rate-limiting
CIS_ISP_7.rationale: Disables transmission of ICMP redirects to neutralize MitM redirection attacks and throttles error replies.

CIS_ISP_8.title: Disable unauthorized Web Proxy and SOCKS servers
CIS_ISP_8.rationale: Misconfigured or open proxies allow attackers to abuse the router as an anonymizing proxy or pivot hop.

CIS_CORP_1.title: Disable built-in Bandwidth-Test server ('btest')
CIS_CORP_1.rationale: An unauthenticated bandwidth test server can be abused to exhaust CPU resources and saturate corporate uplinks.

CIS_CORP_2.title: Disable MAC-WinBox and MAC-Telnet on user access interfaces
CIS_CORP_2.rationale: Layer 2 MAC-based management bypasses IP firewall filters and must not be exposed on end-user access ports.

CIS_CORP_3.title: Strict SSH hardening (Ed25519 strong keys only, disable password auth)
CIS_CORP_3.rationale: Eliminates password guessing vulnerabilities and enforces modern public-key cryptography with Ed25519.

CIS_CORP_4.title: DHCP Snooping and Option 82 enforcement on switching bridges
CIS_CORP_4.rationale: Blocks rogue DHCP servers on untrusted bridge ports and inserts Option 82 sub-options for circuit tracking.

CIS_CORP_5.title: Eradicate SNMP v1/v2c (enforce SNMPv3 USM with SHA-256 and AES)
CIS_CORP_5.rationale: SNMP v1/v2c transmits community strings in plaintext; SNMPv3 delivers cryptographic authentication and privacy.

CIS_CORP_6.title: Comprehensive audit streaming to Centralized Syslog (account, system,info, firewall,info)
CIS_CORP_6.rationale: Guarantees real-time streaming of authentication records, configuration modifications, and firewall drops.

CIS_CORP_7.title: Disable RoMON and discovery protocols (MNDP/CDP/LLDP) on user segments
CIS_CORP_7.rationale: RoMON enables out-of-band L2 bridging and discovery; must remain deactivated on untrusted user segments.

CIS_CORP_8.title: Mandatory AES-256 encryption on binary backups and exports
CIS_CORP_8.rationale: Router backups contain credentials and network secrets; mandatory AES encryption prevents unauthorized exfiltration.

syslog_centralizado.name: Centralized RoSGrid Syslog

cake_qos.name: CAKE QoS Bufferbloat Mitigation & Fair Queueing
cake_qos.description: Advanced Bufferbloat mitigation using CAKE (Common Applications Kept Enhanced) algorithm with per-host flow isolation (triple-isolate) and RTT congestion control on WAN.

copp_cpu.name: CoPP CPU Protection & Management Plane Rate-Limiting
copp_cpu.description: Comprehensive Control Plane Policing (CoPP) rate-limiting BGP, OSPF, ICMP, DNS, and SSH packets destined to router CPU to mitigate Denial-of-Service attacks.

bridge_vlan.name: Bridge VLAN Filtering Trunk & Access Hardening
bridge_vlan.description: L2 switching segmentation with strict Bridge VLAN Filtering (802.1Q), isolating trunk uplinks and user access ports while discarding untagged frames.

cgnat_rfc6598.name: CGNAT Carrier-Grade NAT Pool & RFC 6598 Deterministic
cgnat_rfc6598.description: Carrier-Grade NAT (CGNAT) bulk provisioning with RFC 6598 shared address space (100.64.0.0/10) and deterministic port allocation to public WAN transit IP.

bcp38_urpf.name: BCP 38 Anti-Spoofing & Unicast RPF (uRPF) Strict
bcp38_urpf.description: IP Anti-Spoofing defense compliant with IETF BCP 38 / RFC 2827 and strict Unicast Reverse Path Forwarding (uRPF) on WAN edge and customer BGP interfaces.

bgp_rpki.name: BGP RPKI Route Origin Authorization (ROA) Validation
bgp_rpki.description: BGP Route Origin Authorization (RPKI ROA) validation to eliminate route hijacking via RouterOS v7 RPKI cache servers and automatic prefix invalidation.

sdwan_wireguard.name: SD-WAN WireGuard Hub-and-Spoke Interconnection
sdwan_wireguard.description: Automated SD-WAN overlay deployment over WireGuard with BGP/OSPF dynamic routing, Curve25519 cryptographic keys, and Multi-WAN failover.

vrrp_gateway.name: VRRP Dual-Router Gateway Redundancy
vrrp_gateway.description: Dual-router default gateway redundancy via VRRP (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol v3) with sub-second failover timers.

encrypted_sftp_backup.name: Encrypted SFTP Cloud Configuration Backup Automation
encrypted_sftp_backup.description: Scheduled encrypted binary backup (AES-256) and configuration export automation to corporate SFTP repository with automated rotation.

dhcp_snooping_dai.name: DHCP Snooping & Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) L2 Shield
dhcp_snooping_dai.description: Layer 2 switching shield combining DHCP Snooping with Option 82 and Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) to eradicate Rogue DHCP servers and ARP poisoning.

ntp_cloud.name: Cloudflare / Google NTP Time Synchronization
ntp_cloud.description: Redundant time synchronization against Cloudflare and Google NTP pool servers (NTP Client v7).

dns_doh.name: Secure DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) Cloudflare
dns_doh.description: Secure DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) configuration using Cloudflare upstream and SSL certificate verification.
